ctx.x: Zooty, yeah. Zooty played a good while with him in the show. Uh-huh. And then, uh, they were starting around, right after World War I, 1920, 21, like that. Then Zooty went away. Happy came in that band. That was a regular show drummer. Yeah. Red Happy.
